guideline: Picking is opt-in: pickable defaults to false per layer.
keywords: picking; pickable; hover; opt-in; interaction; picking hover
do: Set pickable:true only on layers that need hover or click.
dont: Expect hover or click events from layers left at the default.
code_bad: new ScatterplotLayer({id:'pts', data}); // never fires onHover

guideline: onHover fires when the hovered object changes; onClick fires on every click on a pickable object. Set them per layer or on Deck; getTooltip renders a default tooltip.
keywords: onHover; onClick; getTooltip; tooltip; callbacks; hover event
do: Use getTooltip for simple tooltips and layer or Deck callbacks for custom behaviour.
dont: Build a DOM tooltip on every mouse move.

guideline: Layer props autoHighlight, highlightColor and highlightedObjectIndex depend on pickable.
keywords: autoHighlight; highlightColor; highlightedObjectIndex; hover highlight; pickable
do: Enable pickable together with autoHighlight and highlightColor for hover feedback.
dont: Set autoHighlight on a layer that is not pickable.

guideline: Picking draws pickable layers off-screen while panning and hovering. Limits: 16M items per layer and 256 layers with pickable:true.
keywords: picking cost; offscreen picking; pickable limit; 16M items; 256 layers; performance
do: Keep pickable only on layers users interact with; stay under the 16M item and 256 layer limits.

guideline: updateTriggers is an object keyed by accessor name whose values are variables affecting the accessor output. Without one, the accessor is not re-run when its closure changes.
keywords: updateTriggers; accessor; getFillColor; closure; layer not updating; stale colors
do: Declare updateTriggers for each accessor that reads outside state.
dont: Change a closure variable and expect the accessor to re-run on its own.
code_good: new ScatterplotLayer({getFillColor: d => ramp(d, mode), updateTriggers:{getFillColor:[mode]}})
code_bad: new ScatterplotLayer({getFillColor: d => ramp(d, mode)}); // stale after mode changes

guideline: A new data prop outranks updateTriggers and refreshes all attributes.
keywords: data prop; refresh attributes; updateTriggers; full update; recompute
do: Change updateTriggers, not data, to refresh a single attribute.
dont: Replace data just to change colours.

guideline: Use the visible prop instead of conditional rendering to hide a layer.
keywords: visible; hide layer; toggle layer; conditional rendering; layer toggle
do: Toggle layers with visible:false so deck.gl keeps the layer state.
dont: Remove the layer from the layers array to hide it.

guideline: Layer onError can mark an error handled so it does not bubble to Deck's onError. It is the per-layer error hook for a retry state.
keywords: onError; layer error; error handling; retry; handled; tile load error
do: Handle layer errors with onError and show a per-layer retry state.
dont: Let one layer failure take down the whole view.

guideline: Scale: interactive up to about 1M items; 10-20 FPS near 10M; Chrome's 1 GB allocation limit makes layers crash between 10M and 100M items; phones are more memory-sensitive.
keywords: scale; million points; 10M; fps; memory; mobile; large dataset; chrome limit
do: Plan for aggregation or tiling beyond about 1M items, and budget lower on phones.
dont: Load tens of millions of raw items in one layer.

guideline: Pass the same data object between renders (shallow compare) or supply dataComparator.
keywords: data comparator; shallow compare; same data object; rerender; dataComparator
do: Keep data referentially stable or provide dataComparator.
dont: Create a new data array on every render.
code_bad: new ScatterplotLayer({data: raw.map(f)}) // new array every render

guideline: Binary data: pass {src: Float32Array, length: N} as data. Accessors can read index and data and write into target.
keywords: binary data; Float32Array; typed array; accessor target; large data
do: Supply typed-array binary data for very large layers.
dont: Build millions of JS objects for a layer.
code_good: new ScatterplotLayer({data:{src: positions, length: n}, getPosition:(o,{index,data,target}) => { target[0]=data.src[index*2]; target[1]=data.src[index*2+1]; return target; }})

guideline: External attribute buffers (typed arrays or luma.gl Buffers) can skip CPU attribute generation. Colours sent as floats must be normalised to 0-1.
keywords: attribute buffers; luma.gl Buffer; normalized colors; GPU; skip CPU attributes
do: Pass prebuilt attribute buffers and normalise float colours to 0-1.
dont: Send float colours in the 0-255 range.

guideline: GeoJsonLayer accepts a flat binary feature collection (shape: 'binary-feature-collection'); MVTLayer uses it by default and geojsonToBinary converts.
keywords: GeoJsonLayer binary; binary-feature-collection; geojsonToBinary; MVTLayer; large geojson
do: Convert large GeoJSON with geojsonToBinary before passing it to GeoJsonLayer.
dont: Pass very large GeoJSON as plain objects.

guideline: MapboxOverlay renders overlaid by default (interleaved:false, separate canvas). With interleaved:true layers join the base map's layer stack and share its WebGL context; order them with beforeId or slot. Layers with the same beforeId render in batches.
keywords: MapboxOverlay; interleaved; beforeId; slot; layer order; basemap labels; overlay
do: Use interleaved:true with beforeId or slot to put deck.gl layers under basemap labels.
dont: Expect separate-canvas overlay mode to place layers beneath basemap labels.

guideline: In interleaved mode MaskExtension and CollisionFilterExtension only work between layers in the same beforeId/slot group; base-map contexts have antialias:false, so PathLayer, LineLayer, ArcLayer and PointCloudLayer look aliased unless you set their antialiasing prop.
keywords: interleaved; MaskExtension; CollisionFilterExtension; antialias; aliasing; PathLayer; ArcLayer
do: Keep extension-linked layers in one beforeId/slot group and set antialiasing on line-like layers.
dont: Split mask or collision-filter layers across different beforeId groups.

guideline: In interleaved mode useDevicePixels is ignored and getCanvas returns the base map's canvas.
keywords: useDevicePixels; getCanvas; interleaved; device pixel ratio; canvas
do: Control resolution through the base map when interleaved.
dont: Set useDevicePixels expecting it to apply in interleaved mode.

guideline: Overdraw hurts performance: 5 px scatterplot points cost about 100 pixels each, so 10M points can mean up to about 1 billion fragments.
keywords: overdraw; fragments; scatterplot; radius; pixel cost; performance
do: Aggregate or reduce point radius at low zoom to limit overdraw.
dont: Draw millions of large overlapping points.
